- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 1518-1519 and 1566 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: When a commit command uses `env -C /does-not-exist` (a non-existent directory), the guard resolves the directory as `None` via `_literal_guard_path` (line 491), falls back to the session checkout as `invocation.cwd` (line 539), sets `warning = "could not resolve git command directory; checking the session checkout instead"` (line 542), but at line 1518-1519 only calls `_warn(target.warning)` without adding to `confirmation_reasons` or `continue`-ing past the PR check.
  WHY: The CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails on this test, causing the aggregate `lint` check to fail (failed_count=2). The PR cannot merge with red CI. This code entered the PR HEAD via the `[ai-merge-resolve]` merge commit (160 lines changed in the guard), not via the PR's own changes, but the PR's HEAD includes it and CI runs against it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
